About ireland.ie 2026 St Patrick's Day Events in Washington, D.C., Maryland, Virginia, and West Virginia Explore St. Patrick's Day celebrations taking place across Washington, D.C., Maryland, Virginia, and West Virginia throughout the month of March. 2 March 2026 All events listed are free and open to the public. Please refer to the links below for the latest information on each event. Washington, D.C. Saturday, March 14: Ireland at The Wharf Maryland AnnapolisSaturday, March 7 - Sunday, March 8: Annapolis St. Patrick's Day Parade and FestivalBaltimoreSunday, March 15: Baltimore's St. Patrick ParadeChevy ChaseFriday, March 6 at 3pm: Irish Network DC Six Nations Rugby Watch Party (Ireland vs. Wales)Saturday, March 14 at 10am: Irish Network DC Six Nations Rugby Watch Party (Ireland vs. Scotland)GaithersburgSaturday, March 14: Gaithersburg St. Patrick's Day ParadeOcean CitySaturday, March 14: Ocean City St. Patrick's Day Parade and Festival (Delmarva Irish-American Club) Virginia AlexandriaSaturday, March 7: Ballyshaners St. Patrick's Day ParadeManassasSaturday, March 14th: Greater Manassas St. Patrick's Day ParadeNorfolkSaturday, March 14th: Norfolk St. Patrick's Day Parade West Virginia IrelandSunday, March 8 - Friday, March 20: Irish Spring FestivalMartinsburgSaturday, March 14: Main Street Martinsburg St. Patrick's Day Celebration You may also be interested in these articles 10 February 2026 Celebrating General Stephen Moylan at Villanova As part of Ireland's America250 programming, Ambassador Geraldine Byrne Nason delivered a keynote address at Villanova University to commemorate the contributions of the Cork-born Brigadier General of the Continental Army, Stephen Moylan. Read more 6 February 2026 Minister McEntee visits Washington, D.C. The Minister for Foreign Affairs and Trade & Minister for Defence, Helen McEntee TD, undertook her first trip to Washington, D.C. since her appointment as Minister. The two-day programme featured a series of political, economic, and community engagements aimed at further strengthening Ireland’s close relationship with the United States. Read more 18 December 2025 Season's greetings from the Embassy The Embassy of Ireland, USA marked the holiday season with a reception celebrating the strong and enduring partnership between Ireland and the United States. Read more 15 December 2025 AI for the Holidays In partnership with Washington AI Network and presented by Pinterest, the Embassy hosted an ‘AI for the Holidays’ reception highlighting Ireland as a dynamic hub for innovation.
